create.name: Dr. Rubin Naiman
create.bio:
Rubin Naiman is an American psychologist who has spent most of the past 35 years on sleep and dreams, and whose writing and teaching regard night as a spiritual as well as a physical matter. Born in Europe and raised in New York and on a farm in South Jersey, he went to Rutgers meaning to become a rabbi, later earned a doctorate in clinical psychology, and is an ordained minister. He ran a private practice for four decades, led sleep programmes at Canyon Ranch and Miraval in Tucson, and is a clinical assistant professor at the Andrew Weil Center for Integrative Medicine.

Now retired from clinical practice, he offers consultations by video worldwide that teach transpersonal ways of understanding sleep and dreaming, including dreamwork, drawing on Jungian and archetypal ideas. His books bring sleep science together with contemplative and sacred views of night: Healing Night explores sleeping, dreaming and awakening as states of consciousness, Hush is a nightly reader of short bedtime contemplations, and The Yoga of Sleep is an audio programme of guided practices such as a mindful surrender to sleep. He teaches at retreat centres, including the Sivananda Ashram in the Bahamas, and lives in Tucson, Arizona.

books.title: Healing Night: The Science and Spirit of Sleeping, Dreaming, and Awakening
books.author: Rubin R. Naiman
books.description: A look at sleeping, dreaming and waking as states of consciousness, setting sleep science beside reflections on the sacred character of night and offering practices for restful sleep and richer dreaming.

books.title: Hush: A Book of Bedtime Contemplations
books.author: Rubin R. Naiman
books.description: A bedside reader of one hundred short spiritual reflections, one for each night, meant to be read slowly before sleep rather than studied.

books.title: The Yoga of Sleep
books.author: Rubin R. Naiman
books.description: A two-CD audio programme that joins sleep research with wisdom traditions, with five guided practices for the hours around sleep, among them a mindful surrender to sleep and a practice for waking.

courses.title: Consciousness consultations and dreamwork
courses.description: One-to-one video sessions, offered worldwide, in which he teaches transpersonal and spiritual ways of understanding sleep and dreams and works with clients' dreams. Fees are given on enquiry, with a sliding scale available.
